ns2:section.sectionText: Criteria: For graduate or undergraduate students who have successfully completed an IBC project and are active members of IBC in the semester they take the course, or for MBA students, regardless of whether they have completed a project or are new hires into IBC. Titled ?Small Business Consulting,? this class will combine classroom teaching focused on more in-depth consulting practices as well as participation in an IBC project. This is designed to complement your IBC project experience. Need departmental approval before student can register. Contact Liezl Bowman at liezlb@illinois.edu for registration information.
